chunks: What you are calling me to is surely not worth the calling in this world or in the next, because our returning is to God; and because the transgressors will be inmates of Hell.

key_terms.الْمُسْرِفِينَ: The transgressors / Those who exceed limits

ai.seo_question: Who are the transgressors and where will they reside according to this verse?
ai.summary: In the context of Surah Ghafir, this verse highlights the futility of idolatrous calls, noting they possess no authority in the temporal or spiritual realms, thereby reinforcing the monotheistic principle of ultimate return to Allah. It specifically identifies the 'transgressors' (al-musrifin) as those who exceed bounds in disbelief, a key concept in Shia exegesis linking excessive deviation to eternal punishment.
